items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: this man lives next door here, Mr. Lane, he had a brother they buried him a few years ago. He used to be a good trombone player too.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with any of those fellas? Richard Brunus, Henry Brunus? No, never did. I wondered uh Happy Schilling, do you remember Happy Schilling, a trombone player? No, I don't remember him either. He was uptown too. And uh Tom Brown, do you remember Tom Brown?

No, I don't know nothing of him either. You don't remember? No, this man lives next door here, Mr. Lane, he had a brother they buried him a few years ago. He used to be a good trombone player too. Oh yeah, which uh Julian Lane?

Julian Lane. Julian Lane. Julian, yeah. Julian, yeah. Yeah, he's about two years now, I think he's dead. No, he's brother. Oh, I mean in the other house? In the half house, yeah. Does his brother play any instruments?
